description: Sierra Wireless modules (USB 1199): MC73xx/MC74xx, EM73xx/EM74xx/EM75xx, EM91xx; Qualcomm based, serial ports on qcserial (older ones on the sierra driver, data on sierra_net), data over QMI or MBIM. ModemManager owns them. Their firmware loaders (1199:907a, 1199:9090) are a service mode, never a modem; the EM74xx compositions with a profile of their own win over this family. Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: ModemManager src/plugins/sierra, the imported catalog (14 IDs), another modem manager modem/usb list 3.9.43; the owner, 2026-11-13

radio.source: the family's AT set as the model profile sierra-em74xx documents it (its sources there); under ModemManager the radio is read and set through ModemManager's own plugin, the dialect is for an AT port the engine holds itself
